purpose: Teach: 侵攻/搾取/転落/談話/快楽/湾岸/丸山/セックス

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、隣国への侵攻を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote about the neighboring country's invasion in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant curiosity. Gentle opening — she's checking in, not testing. Patient pacing. The tone of a teacher who has actually read the work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、植民地時代の搾取を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on colonial exploitation.
lines.style: Careful, earnest. Brief but not evasive. A slight pause before answering, like he's gauging whether his actual topic will land. Respectful.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、王朝の転落の歴史を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And you looked at the fall of dynasties throughout history, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, inviting. She's not interrogating — she's drawing him out. A beat of genuine interest before speaking. Steady, unhurried.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、首相の談話を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I analyzed prime ministerial statements on that.
lines.style: Direct, sincere. He's committing to his answer without hedging. Quiet confidence underneath. Still respectful but slightly more settled.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 快楽主義の哲学を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: You covered hedonism in your philosophical work, then?
lines.style: Gently probing, encouraging further detail. A soft lift at the end — open-ended. She's listening closely, not rushing him through.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、湾岸地域の経済を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — through the lens of Gulf region economics.
lines.style: Quietly committed to his path. No defensiveness, but a slight firmness — he knows what he wrote about and why. Clear, grounded.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、丸山真男の思想を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And Maruyama Masao's thought — that's where your focus went?
lines.style: Engaged, recognizing depth. Slight warmth in her voice now — she's impressed by the scope of his thinking. Present, attentive. Natural conversation rhythm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、人類学的視点からセックスと社会の関係を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined the relationship between sexuality and society from an anthropological perspective.
lines.style: Forthright, anchored. He's delivering his most complex answer with clarity and quiet pride. No stumbling. The slight relief of reaching the end — exhale soft on the final phrase.
